001package edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.hilt;
002
003import android.content.Context;
004import androidx.room.Room;
005import dagger.Module;
006import dagger.Provides;
007import dagger.hilt.InstallIn;
008import dagger.hilt.android.qualifiers.ApplicationContext;
009import dagger.hilt.components.SingletonComponent;
010import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.dao.PinDao;
011import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.dao.TrackDao;
012import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.dao.UserDao;
013import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.service.PinDatabase;
014import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.service.Preloader;
015import javax.inject.Singleton;
016
017/**
018 * A Hilt module for providing database and DAO dependencies.
019 * This module configures bindings in the Hilt dependency injection
020 * framework to supply a singleton instance of the {@link PinDatabase}
021 * and its associated DAOs.
022 */
023@Module
024@InstallIn(SingletonComponent.class)
025public class DatabaseModule {
026
027  /**
028   * Creates and provides a singleton instance of the {@link PinDatabase} configured with the
029   * specified application context and preloader callback. The created database includes preloading
030   * functionality to initialize data on creation.
031   *
032   * @param context the application {@link Context} used to create the database instance.
033   * @param callback the {@link Preloader} responsible for performing actions when the database is created.
034   * @return a singleton instance of {@link PinDatabase}.
035   */
036  @Provides
037  @Singleton
038  PinDatabase provideDatabase(@ApplicationContext Context context, Preloader callback) {
039    return Room.databaseBuilder(context,
040            PinDatabase.class, PinDatabase.getDatabaseName())
041        .addCallback(callback)
042        .build();
043  }
044
045  /**
046   * Provides an instance of {@link PinDao} for accessing and manipulating the "pins" table within the
047   * {@link PinDatabase}.
048   *
049   * @param database the instance of {@link PinDatabase} from which the {@link PinDao} is obtained.
050   * @return a singleton instance of {@link PinDao}.
051   */
052  @Provides
053  @Singleton
054  PinDao providePinDao(PinDatabase database) {
055    return database.getPinDao();
056  }
057
058  /**
059   * Provides an instance of {@link UserDao} for accessing and manipulating the "user" table within the
060   * {@link PinDatabase}.
061   *
062   * @param pinDatabase the {@link PinDatabase} instance used to obtain the {@link UserDao}.
063   * @return a singleton instance of {@link UserDao}.
064   */
065  @Provides
066  @Singleton
067  UserDao provideUserDao(PinDatabase pinDatabase) {
068    return pinDatabase.getUserDao();
069  }
070
071  /**
072   * Provides an instance of {@link TrackDao} for accessing and manipulating the "track" table
073   * within the {@link PinDatabase}.
074   *
075   * @param pinDatabase the {@link PinDatabase} instance used to obtain the {@link TrackDao}.
076   * @return a singleton instance of {@link TrackDao}.
077   */
078  @Provides
079  @Singleton
080  TrackDao provideTrackDao(PinDatabase pinDatabase) {
081    return pinDatabase.getTrackDao();
082  }
083}
